name: CodeRabbit
tagline: Hosted AI PR reviewer with summaries, linter/SAST integration, and agentic chat across GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, and Bitbucket.
pricing: Free tier (summaries); Pro $24/dev/mo (annual); Pro Plus $48/dev/mo; Enterprise custom. Hourly review rate limits per tier (5/10/12 per dev)
selfHostedNote: Self-hosted deployment on custom-priced Enterprise; docs cite availability for orgs with 500+ seats, connecting to your own LLM provider.
modelControl: Fixed vendor models; no BYOK on standard plans (own LLM provider only on self-hosted Enterprise)

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Diff plus related files, learnings, linters/SAST; linked-repo analysis capped (1 on Pro, 10 on Pro Plus).

02-rule-centric.note: Custom instructions, path filters, and a quieter review profile; default posture is verbose.

03-dual-workflow.note: IDE extensions (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf) and CLI pre-commit reviews alongside PR reviews.

04-business-logic.note: Jira and Linear integration on paid plans; checks changes against linked tickets.

05-continuous-learning.note: Learnings accumulate from team replies; stops flagging patterns you tell it are fine.

06-sandbox-validation.note: Pro Plus adds pre-merge checks and unit test generation; no documented sandbox execution of findings.

07-economic-transparency.note: No BYOK or model choice on standard plans; model costs bundled into seat price.

08-actionability.note: One-click committable suggestions, agentic chat on the PR, and fix flows via IDE extensions.

09-measurable-roi.note: Analytics and reports on paid tiers; no documented token-level cost or DORA ROI reporting.
